title: SB2193 (113th General Assembly): AN ACT to amend Tennessee Code Annotated, Title 39, Chapter 17, relative to firearm sales.

provenance.fetched_by: LegiScan bulk data (gun-policy Stage 5, Tennessee); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Tennessee text (Draft, 2024-01-30; official copy via the Internet Archive snapshot 20260514141716 of https://www.capitol.tn.gov/Bills/113/Bill/SB2193.pdf (LegiScan doc 2906916))
provenance.note: Draft as filed (2024-01-30), same document as HB 2277 twin. No amendments in text.

operative_text:
SECTION 1 (TCA 39-17-1316(a)(1)): deleting the language "persons who have been convicted of the offense of stalking" and substituting "persons who are under twenty-one (21) years of age, persons who have been convicted of the offense of stalking"
SECTION 2 (TCA 39-17-1316(q)(4)): (4) It is an offense to sell or offer to sell a firearm to a person knowing that the person is under twenty-one (21) years of age.
